children: VANCOUVER, BC, September 17, 2026 – TheNewswire - Ventra Metals Corp. (“Ventra” or the “Company”)
is pleased to announce that shareholders approved all resolutions presented at its annual general and special meeting held on September 16, 2026 (the “Meeting”).
A total of 5,946,600 common shares were voted at the Meeting representing 36.77% of the issued and outstanding common shares. At the Meeting:
The number of directors was set at five with Sean McGrath, Mason Granger, Todd Burlingame, Scott Smith and Shawn Nicholas elected;
Saturna Group, Chartered Professional Accountants LLP, was appointed as auditor;
The adoption of the Company’s omnibus incentive plan (the “Omnibus Plan”) was approved by disinterested shareholders of the Company; and
The granting of 1,125,000 incentive stock options pursuant to the Omnibus Plan was approved by disinterested shareholders of the Company.

Ventra Metals Corp. is a mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition, exploration and development of resource properties prospective for critical metals and advancing energy sector opportunities throughout North America. The Company’s current focus is advancing exploration on the TT property located in central Labrador, Canada. The Company also continues to evaluate opportunities to expand and diversify its portfolio while maintaining a disciplined approach to capital allocation and shareholder value creation.

title: Ventra Metals Announces Results Of Annual General And Special Meeting Of Shareholders
